manual.assorteddecor.chapter.decorations: A bone decoration needs no firing. Place it and right click to cycle through the shapes.

Clay decorations are crafted unfired and have to go through a furnace before they are any use.

Once placed, right click to cycle through the options.
A fountain block pushes water up out of itself, for a courtyard that needed a middle.

A planter pot is crafted unfired and has to go through a furnace before it will hold anything.

Once placed, right click to cycle through the filling material. The pot supports whichever plants suit the filling material it is set to.
manual.assorteddecor.description: Blocks that take on the look of other blocks, plus furniture, lights, decorations, wall art, roads and more.
manual.assorteddecor.title: Assorted Decor
